params.name: uploadId
params.description: The Emerge ID of the build to analyze. Required if not using platform+appId+version combination.

params.name: platform
params.description: The platform of the app ('ios' or 'android'). Required if not using uploadId.

params.name: appId
params.description: The bundle ID or package name of the app. Required if not using uploadId.

params.name: version
params.description: The version of the app. Required if not using uploadId.

params.name: page
params.description: The current page to request data for in the event of pagination. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

items.docs: Returns the Reaper analysis results for a given build. You can identify the build using either an uploadId OR a combination of platform, appId, and version.
